dedupe_keys.name: traffic counts on the national road network of luxembourg ponts et chaussees and the digital mobility observatory

description: The Luxembourg roads administration, the Administration des Ponts et Chaussées, publishes traffic counts on the national road network as an open dataset on the national data portal. The dataset was created in February 2018, has one file, is tagged as monthly, and was last updated on 3 October 2022, under a CC0 licence. Its one listed reuse is the Digital Mobility Observatory (ODM) of the Ministry of Mobility and Public Works, published in May 2023 and last updated in July 2025, which gathers information relevant to mobility planning for journalists, municipalities, consultancies and the public: results of studies and surveys, links to planning tools such as a cycling map and the veloplangen.lu simulator, and interactive dashboards on flows of people across the country, vehicle flows on the roads, passenger flows on public transport and the change in the vehicle fleet, using datasets that include the national vehicle register export. Access is free. Caveats: the portal rates the traffic count metadata low, with no description or file documentation, and the update frequency has not been kept since 2022. Coverage is Luxembourg's national roads. It supports network flow and capacity planning analysis of road traffic; the related record is the Vegagerðin road data services of Iceland.
